name: bash
description: Execute a shell command on the host machine through the sandboxed nexus shell service. Runs through the host default shell (bash on POSIX, cmd on Windows) so pipes, &&, ||, and shell built-ins are permitted. Default timeout 120s; stdout/stderr each capped at 30 KB. Background execution is not supported.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: The shell command line to execute. Forwarded verbatim to the host shell, so pipes, redirects, environment-variable assignments, and shell built-ins all work.

inputs.name: timeout
inputs.description: Per-call wall-clock timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000ms (2 minutes); maximum 600000ms (10 minutes). The service hard-caps at the maximum regardless of the requested value.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Short human-readable description (5-12 words) of what the command does. Surfaced in tool-call telemetry; does not affect execution.
